Synthetic, closed-set, 26 glyphs, 520 trials, seed 20261025.

> **Read [methodology.md](methodology.md) first.** These samples are generated from the
> author's own glyph templates. The numbers measure *self-consistency and robustness*, not
> accuracy on human handwriting. Do not quote them as a recognition rate.

## Coverage audit

Declared by `InkRecognizer.SPECS` but **never emitted** in any trial:

`3`, `a`, `alpha`, `div`, `in`, `infty`, `mapsto`, `mul`, `n`, `power`, `reals`, `y`, `z`

A symbol that can never be the top prediction is unreachable through the ink path, regardless of how well it is drawn. This is a specification gap in the classifier, not a property of the benchmark data.
